affected_locations: Dakshin Bedkashi Union, Koyra Upazila, Khulna District, Bangladesh
key_impacts: In Dakshin Bedkashi Union, 33 people were killed
In Dakshin Bedkashi Union, 3,520 houses washed away and 1,800 partially damaged
Storm surge overtopped and breached embankments (6 breaches), damaging 20.55 km and causing widespread inundation
evidence_snippets: Cyclone Aila hit the Bangladesh coast on 25 May 2009 with 65 knots and a 2–6 m storm surge.
In Dakshin Bedkashi… killed 33 people, washed away 3,520 houses, partially damaged 1,800, and inundated almost the entire union.
The storm surge overtopped the coastal embankment, breached it in six places and damaged 20.55 km of embankment.
